title: Fix: Sol S1 on PR #631 (optional choice in creation wizard) (Sonnet 5.5)
description:
Fix the MATERIAL finding from the Sol review of PR #631 (read in full: `bd show eshyra-mdke.2`). Branch from origin/eshyra-mdke. Deps installed. Edit only packages/cli/src/characterWizard.ts and packages/cli/test/characterWizard.test.ts (do not change core; keep satisfied=true for an empty optional choice in the engine).

The creation wizard's runChoiceGroup (~1006-1018, ~1047-1056) treats satisfied as "already answered": for an OPTIONAL choice (choice.optional / the favored-enemy-language choice) with an empty selection it shows no options and "Enter to keep, or clear", and clear advances without re-prompting. Fix: when a choice is optional and its selection is empty, show the numbered options with an explicit "press Enter to skip" prompt; a populated optional choice shows the selection with keep/clear, and clear returns to the picker (does not auto-advance). Required choices behave exactly as today.

EVIDENCE: one generalized optional-choice wizard regression (Human Ranger, humanoids + gnoll/orc): initial empty display lists language options; Enter skips and finalizes; picking a language persists it (lands on sheet.languages after finalize); clear on a populated choice re-shows the picker and a new pick replaces it. Confirm the new test fails on the pre-fix wizard.

PROTOCOL: `npm run verify:worktree` BEFORE committing; commit on your branch; `bd update <your-bead> --append-notes`; `bd close <your-bead>`. Do not push or open/comment on PRs.
notes: Commit 83e7088b. Fix in packages/cli/src/characterWizard.ts runChoiceGroup: optional+empty choice is treated as unanswered (shows options + 'Optional — press Enter to skip.', Enter skips and advances, a pick auto-advances); populated optional keeps keep/clear and clear returns to picker. Engine satisfied=true unchanged. Test: 'character wizard — optional choice' in packages/cli/test/characterWizard.test.ts (Human Ranger humanoids gnoll/orc: initial display, skip, pick persists to sheet.languages, clear+repick). Fails on pre-fix wizard (no option list), passes after. verify:worktree green (6185 passed, 3 skipped).
